messages:
Jordan (Eng Manager): Quick q — one of my ICs is planning parental leave that overlaps our Q2 performance cycle. How should I handle mid-cycle check-ins and the calibration deadline? Don't want to disadvantage them.
Anna (People Ops): Thanks for flagging, @Jordan. We have a standard approach: keep regular check-ins before leave, mark leave period in the review doc, and managers should not penalize for missed objectives during approved leave. We can give a case-specific extension for calibration deadlines. I'll outline steps.
Leo (People Ops): Adding: if >4 weeks of leave overlapping review window, we usually pause formal rating and shift to a deferred review in the next cycle, or allow manager-calibrated rating with HR oversight.
Maria (Backend IC): For context: planned leave is 6 weeks starting Apr 15, returns May 31. Will be fully OOO. Need to know if goals will be frozen or adjusted.
Anna (People Ops): For 6w we recommend deferral of development-objective assessment; do a lightweight feedback checkpoint for growth but defer the formal rating. Manager should capture pre-leave evidence + handover notes.
Jordan (Eng Manager): How does this affect comp and the calibration deadlines? Our comp cycle syncs tightly with ratings.
Anna (People Ops): We can decouple comp timing: if review is deferred, comp increase timing may move to next review. For exceptions, escalate to People Ops + Comp. @Leo can help with comp cases.
Leo (People Ops): Yep — we'll need to log the case in HRIS and confirm with Comp. Send me the employee name, manager rating draft, and the leave dates.
hr-bot: Reminder: Parental Leave policy v2.1 — https://handbook.redwood.ai/benefits/parental-leave. Use the 'Review Leave' flow on PeoplePortal to mark dates.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Okay. Action items: I'll gather pre-leave evidence + send to Leo. @Maria, are you comfortable being listed as 'deferred' for Q2 formal rating?
Maria (Backend IC): That's fine. Also, can I request a short check-in 2 weeks after return before the calibration window closes?
Anna (People Ops): Absolutely — we encourage a return check-in. If the calibration window closes before that, we do a deferred review. Manager should note in the calibration doc: 'Leave overlap — deferred to next cycle unless manager & HR agree otherwise.'
Jordan (Eng Manager): Thanks. One last: do we need any paperwork to formalize deferral?
Leo (People Ops): No extra paperwork. People Ops will record the deferral in HRIS and annotate the review doc. I'll create the case and ping Comp if needed.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Great, thanks all :thumbsup:
hr-bot: Case logged: PL-1978001234. People Ops will follow up within 3 business days.
